title: Protein-coding Gene Annotation Protocol for the Eastern Banjo Frog
author: Qiye Li
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bc38iyrw

steps.title: Download Vertebrate Protein Sequences
steps.instruction: Download protein sequences of diverse vertebrate species from the specified sources.

steps.title: Identify Candidate Loci and Exon-Intron Structure
steps.instruction: Align downloaded protein sequences to the Limnodynastes dumerilii dumerilii genome assembly and determine gene structure.

substeps.instruction: Align protein sequences to the genome assembly using TBLASTN (blast-2.2.26).
Extract genomic sequences of candidate loci including 5 kb flanking sequences.
Align homologous proteins to the extracted genomic sequences using GeneWise (wise-2.2.0) for exon-intron structure determinations.

steps.title: Train AUGUSTUS and Predict Genes
steps.instruction: Train the AUGUSTUS gene predictor and apply it to the genome assembly.

substeps.instruction: Randomly pick 1,000 homology-derived gene models of Limnodynastes dumerilii dumerilii with complete open reading frames (ORFs) and reciprocal aligning rates exceeding 90% against X. tropicalis proteins to train AUGUSTUS (v3.3.1, RRID:SCR_008417).
Use the obtained AUGUSTUS gene parameters to predict protein-coding genes on the repeat-masked Limnodynastes dumerilii dumerilii genome assembly.

steps.title: Combine Gene Models
steps.instruction: Combine gene models derived from the two previous methods into a non-redundant gene set using a strategy similar to Xiong et al. (2016).

steps.title: Filter Gene Set
steps.instruction: Remove genes from the combined set that are transposon-related or highly repetitive.

substeps.instruction: Remove genes showing BLASTP (blast-2.2.26) hits to transposon proteins in the UniProtKB/Swiss-Prot database (v2019_11) using parameters "-F F -e 1e-5".
Remove genes with more than 70% of their coding regions overlapping repetitive sequences.

steps.title: Perform Functional Annotation
steps.instruction: Perform functional annotation of Limnodynastes dumerilii dumerilii proteins by searching against public databases.

substeps.instruction: Search proteins against UniProtKB/Swiss-Prot (v2019_11), NCBI nr (v20191030), and KEGG (v93.0) using BLASTP (blast-2.2.26).
Use the parameters "-F F -e 1e-5" when running BLASTP.
